relations.subject: Kuno Lorenz
relations.evidence: Lorenz earned his  Ph.D. in 1961 under Paul Lorenzen in Kiel with a thesis about Arithmetic and Logic as Games.

relations.subject: Kuno Lorenz
relations.evidence: In 1969 he received his habilitation degree in philosophy also under Lorenzen but this time in Erlangen.

relations.subject: Kuno Lorenz
relations.evidence: In 1970 he was offered the chair of philosophy at the University of Hamburg to succeed Carl Friedrich von Weizsäcker.
